device.category: 7-voice, 4-part multitimbral analogue desktop synthesizer with digital chorus and delay
device.based_on: Original design (Buenos Aires, 2022), described as the first polyphonic and multitimbral analogue synthesizer made in Argentina.

sources.title: GS Music e7 User Manual (English)
sources.note: Overview, panels, every section, polyphony modes, global configuration, panel/preset/multitimbral modes, CV, specifications. No CC chart.

sources.title: Synthtopia, 'GS Music Intros e7 Multitimbral Analog Polyphonic Synthesizer' (May 2022)
sources.note: 4-pole low-pass VCF; chorus Basic uses two delay lines and Ensemble four, each with its own LFO; LFO 1, LFO 2 and delay clock-syncable.

sources.title: GS Music, 'GS-e7 MIDI Implementation' (22 September 2022)
sources.note: Official: implementation chart, every CC and value map, program/bank change scheme, SysEx commands, MPE, memory map and 128-byte preset structure.

sources.title: GS Music e7 product page
sources.note: 4-pole ladder filter, LFO frequencies 0.1-100 Hz, stereo motion by an LFO, US$1,899, 3.8 kg.

sources.title: MusicRadar, 'GS Music e7 review' (Andy Jones)
sources.note: One control per function (40+ dials) plus SHIFT; per-oscillator LFO 1/LFO 2 pitch knobs with LFO 3/EG 1 on SHIFT; dedicated LFO waveshape switches.

sources.title: Sound On Sound, 'GS Music e7' review
sources.note: Near one-to-one panel with SHIFT and a few menus; screen shows filter, envelope and oscillator graphics; Voices LEDs follow the VCA envelope.

architecture.polyphony_mode: polyphonic (7), mono single or multi trigger, unison single or multi trigger; up to 4 multitimbral parts sharing the 7 voices; MPE
architecture.patch_memory_note: 512 single presets (1.1.1-8.8.8, 56 factory at 1.1.1-1.7.8) and 128 multitimbral presets (1.1.1-2.8.8, 8 factory). Panel mode plays the knobs live.
architecture.panel_note: Near one control per function (40+ knurled knobs) with a SHIFT layer for secondary labels; dedicated waveshape switches per oscillator and LFO; display and voice LEDs.
architecture.summary: Per voice: two VCOs (over 7 octaves) each with triangle, tri-saw or sawtooth and a switchable variable pulse (10-50%), a square sub one octave down, and white noise or the external input, into a 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass VCF (10 Hz-25 kHz) and a VCA. Audio is fully analogue; controls are digital: two ADSRs per voice (velocity and key tracking on times) and three LFOs, the first two with six sync modes. Voices can be spread and moved across the stereo field, then pass DSP chorus (basic or ensemble) and delay (to 1.35 s, ping-pong, clock sync).

modules.name: MIDI, voice and part allocation
modules.description: Receives MIDI (DIN, USB) and CV pitch; assigns 7 voices per mode, voice option and multitimbral part (channel, key and velocity zones).

modules.name: VCO 1
modules.description: Analogue VCO: triangle, tri-saw or sawtooth (or none) plus a variable pulse (10-50%); transpose ±24 st, tune ±½ st.

modules.name: VCO 2
modules.description: Analogue VCO: triangle, tri-saw or sawtooth (or none) plus a variable pulse (10-50%); transpose ±24 st, tune ±½ st. Can be hard-synced to VCO 1.

modules.name: Noise / external
modules.description: White noise, replaced by the external input when a plug is inserted.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: OSC1, SUB1, OSC2, SUB2 and NOISE/EXT levels.

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: 4-pole ladder 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass, 10 Hz-25 kHz, self-oscillating; exponential CV input.

modules.name: EG 1
modules.description: ADSR (filter-oriented; also pitch, PWM and LFO 2 rate); velocity on attack and release, keyboard tracking on times.

modules.name: EG 2
modules.description: ADSR on the VCA; velocity on attack and release, keyboard tracking.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: EG 2 (with velocity depth), LFO tremolo and keyboard tracking; linear CV gain input. LEVEL sets the preset or part level.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: Triangle, ramp up, ramp down, pulse or S&H; monophonic, polyphonic, keyboard tracking, keyboard sync, clock sync or keyboard + clock sync.

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: Triangle, ramp up, ramp down, pulse or S&H; monophonic, polyphonic, keyboard tracking, keyboard sync, clock sync or keyboard + clock sync. EG 1 can modulate its rate.

modules.name: LFO 3
modules.description: Triangle, ramp up, ramp down or pulse; amplitude zero until mod wheel or aftertouch bring it in.

modules.name: Stereo spread and motion
modules.description: Places the seven voices across the stereo field (spread) and moves them with an internal fixed-rate LFO (motion).

modules.name: Chorus
modules.description: DSP (24-bit, 48 kHz): Basic (two delay lines) or Ensemble (four), each with its own LFO; rate, depth, mix.

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: Stereo or ping-pong, 50 ms-1.35 s, or clock-synced divisions; feedback, mix.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Master volume to balanced L/mono and R outputs and headphones.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: two VCOs and their subs, plus noise or the external input, into the 24 dB low-pass VCF and the VCA (fully analogue). The seven voices are placed by stereo spread and motion, then pass the DSP chorus and delay.

behaviours.name: Waveforms
behaviours.rule: Each VCO selects triangle, tri-saw, sawtooth or none, and the pulse generator mixes in at equal level when on. With no main waveform and pulse on, only the pulse sounds. Subs are squares an octave down.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: EG 1 is aimed at the filter (also pitch, PWM, LFO 2 rate); EG 2 at the VCA. Velocity shortens attack and release; keyboard tracking shortens times for higher notes.

behaviours.name: LFO modes
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 and 2: monophonic (one phase), polyphonic (slightly different rate per key), keyboard tracking (rate follows the note), keyboard sync (phase per key), clock sync (MIDI clock divisions, 120 BPM without clock) or keyboard + clock sync. LFO 3 is silent until the mod wheel or aftertouch bring it in.

behaviours.name: Polyphony modes
behaviours.rule: Poly (7 voices), mono single or multi trigger, unison single or multi trigger (all seven detuned; not in multitimbral patches). Last-note priority in mono and unison. Voice options pick which voices are used (all, even, odd, left-to-right, right-to-left, or a fixed mono voice).

behaviours.name: Multitimbral mode
behaviours.rule: Up to four parts share the seven voices, each with its own sound, MIDI channel, transpose, PB/CC/AT filter, level, key zone and velocity zone. Effects and stereo spread/motion are global. SHIFT + 1-4 selects the part being edited.

behaviours.name: Presets
behaviours.rule: Panel mode plays the knobs; buttons 1-8 select positions, BANK + three digits any address. SHIFT + BANK/SAVE, choose address and name, SAVE. Factory presets can be edited but saved only elsewhere. Copy preset/part options copy patch, patch + FX or FX only.

behaviours.name: CV inputs
behaviours.rule: PITCH (1 V/oct), CUTOFF (exponential) and GAIN (linear) accept 0 to +5 V; autotune takes the PITCH CV voltage as its reference.

receives.note: with bank select: MSB 0 single presets (LSB 0-3 = 128-preset blocks 1.1.1-8.8.8), MSB 1 multitimbral presets
every panel parameter except resonance (see parameter access); 1 mod wheel, 7 master volume, 11 expression (part level), 64 hold, 65 portamento, 50 bend range

receives.parameter: MPE configuration (lower zone only; 0 channels disables)

transmits.note: panel moves on the Tx channel

midi.channel_note: Rx 1-16 or omni (default 1); Tx 1-16 or off; parts may use their own channels. MIDI modes 1-4 and multi mode supported.

memory_map.preset_flash: 0x000000-0x01FFFF (512 single presets x 128 bytes, then 128 multis x 512 bytes = 4 parts)
memory_map.lock_byte: byte 127 (1 = locked from the panel; factory presets locked)

source_inconsistencies: The filter's LFO1 MOD is described as 'modulation from the EG1 to the cutoff frequency'.
SUB2 is described as 'Sub-oscillator 1 level (derived from OSC2)'.
The manual says 'more than 600 presets'; the specifications give 640 and the preset sections 512 + 128.
The specifications list the LFO waveform 'Square'; the LFO section calls it 'Pulse'.
The CC chart has LFO 2 and LFO 3 pulse width depths for both oscillators; the manual describes only EG1 PWM and LFO1 PWM.
The rear panel heading is spelled 'Raer panel' in the contents.
The official preset structure has an LFO 1 EG1 mod byte (55); the manual and CC chart only give EG 1 control of LFO 2's rate.
Weight is 3.75 kg in the manual, 3.8 kg on the product page and '4.6 kg (estimated)' in an early listing.
The product page lists 'Velocity to Attack' for the envelopes; the manual and MIDI implementation also have velocity to release.

modelling_gaps.detail: Secondary controls are marked from the manual's paired labels and MusicRadar's description; a few pairings are assumed.
Voice modules are modelled once (per_voice); LFO 3, stereo, effects and output are common. LFO 1/2 run per voice in their polyphonic modes.
Preset bytes without panel or CC access (LFO 1 EG1 mod) are modelled with SysEx access only.
